identitySignals: BellXcel's page describes the Sperling Center for Research and Innovation (SCRI) as BellXcel's research and innovation center, launched in 2020, and its footer names The B.E.L.L. Foundation, Inc.
The B E L L Foundation Inc is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit (EIN 04-3182053) per ProPublica, based in Needham, MA, near the agenda's Westwood, MA
BellXcel is known for out-of-school-time programs (after-school and summer), matching OUSD's 'After-school & summer programs' category
research.notes: SCRI appears to be a center within BellXcel (legal entity The B.E.L.L. Foundation, Inc., EIN 04-3182053 per ProPublica, Needham MA). The agenda lists Westwood, MA; Westwood address/phone appeared only in search snippets and the sperlingcenter.org site now redirects to bellxcel.org/scri, so contact details and registry IDs were not cited. No page found confirming an Oakland/OUSD relationship, so identity left at medium and legal name/EIN omitted because the contracting entity is not confirmed to be the Foundation.

profile.summary: The Sperling Center for Research and Innovation (SCRI) is the research and innovation center of BellXcel, a nonprofit focused on youth development and out-of-school-time programs. It offers strategy and design, implementation, evaluation, and sector research services to youth-serving organizations and schools.
